The '''TL-1200 transport''' was a [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] manufactured by [[Suwantek Systems]].<ref name="LoNH" />

==Characteristics==
The TL-1200 was a reliable medium-sized freighter with decent cargo capacity. While the ship came equipped with a pair of [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]] mounted on ether side of the bow, many owners chose to add additional weaponry to deal with [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] and other threats.<ref name="LoNH" />

Though not exceptional, the TL-1200 was a solidly built and dependable vessel, and thus it was a relatively common sight throughout the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. In fact, some traders and [[smuggler]]s have been said to seek it out for this very reason, for it tended to go unnoticed where flashier vessels might attract the unwanted attentions of pirates, [[Thief|thieves]], creditors, or criminal syndicates.<ref name="LoNH" />
